Import Feasibility Filter Applied

Physical display: demonstrable, compact, compressible, nestable or knock-down products with good container density. Sample/catalogue: importable items that require packaging or cubic-volume validation. Avoid/phase two: complete kitchens, box beds, sofas, traditional wardrobes, vanity tables and other furniture whose volumetric freight, assembly, damage risk or after-sales service may consume the margin.

How Totals Were Calculated

Monthly category size comes from the Summary sheet. Products, units, average prices and references come only from the Listings sheet.

Sales and units for a product line represent the sum of listings captured in the Top 100 from September 2025 to August 2026. They do not represent Mercado Livre’s total GMV.

September 2026 is shown separately as a partial month.

Duplicate-Control Rules

Listings, brands, sellers and catalogue rankings are independent samples and are never added together.

When a product line appears in more than one category, one primary source is assigned. Other datasets are used only for validation.

Home Furniture is the family-level category. Chairs, Kitchen Furniture and Beds are analytical segments.

Scores from 1 to 5

Demand and growth derive from the data. Private label, importing, regulation, logistics, showroom appeal and competition combine listing evidence with commercial assessment.

For regulatory complexity, 1 means low and 5 means high.

Recommended Use

Use this report for the first showroom assortment. Before purchasing, validate HS/NCM classification, duties, certification, packaging, MOQ, technical support, intellectual property and landed cost in Brazil.
